columns.comment: Credit facility id (FAC-nnnnnn) carrying the covenant; join to fact_facility_terms.
columns.name: facility_id

columns.comment: Covenant: Net Debt/EBITDA (leverage, a maximum) or ICR (interest cover, a minimum).
columns.name: covenant_type

columns.comment: Covenant test date (quarter-end for quarterly tests; the spread date for annual tests).
columns.name: test_date

columns.comment: Credit-system obligor id (CRD-nnnnnn) of the borrower.
columns.name: obligor_id

columns.comment: Surrogate key of the dim_client version valid on this row's date (SCD2 as-was join, D11); join to gold.dim_client.golden_client_sk for the client attributes at that time.
columns.name: golden_client_sk

columns.comment: Durable golden client id from entity resolution (GC-nnnnnn), stable across ER runs and SCD2 versions; one golden client = one resolved legal entity.
columns.name: golden_client_id

columns.comment: Client group (global parent group) id from the Tokyo HO group master (SYN-G-nnnn); join to gold.dim_client_group.
columns.name: client_group_id

columns.comment: Basis of the test: Quarterly (management accounts) or FY<year> Annual (audited annual spread, e.g. FY2025 Annual).
columns.name: test_basis

columns.comment: Covenant family: Leverage (Net Debt/EBITDA) or Interest Cover (ICR).
columns.name: covenant_category

columns.comment: Maximum (actual must stay at or below the threshold, e.g. leverage 4.0x) or Minimum (actual must stay at or above, e.g. ICR 2.5x).
columns.name: covenant_direction

columns.comment: Covenant level in the ratio's unit (x), e.g. 4.0 for Net Debt/EBITDA <= 4.0x.
columns.name: threshold

columns.comment: Tested ratio value (x), e.g. 4.6 for Net Debt/EBITDA of 4.6x.
columns.name: actual

columns.comment: Covenant headroom as a fraction of the threshold (0.08 = 8% headroom; negative = breached).
columns.name: headroom_pct

columns.comment: Headroom band: Breached, 0-10% (tight), 10-20%, 20-30% or 30%+.
columns.name: headroom_bucket

columns.comment: True when the test breached the covenant.
columns.name: is_breached

columns.comment: True when not breached and headroom is below the 10% warning level (0 <= headroom < 0.10, dim_threshold COVENANT_HEADROOM_WARN).
columns.name: is_tight_headroom

columns.comment: True when a waiver was granted for the test.
columns.name: is_waived

columns.comment: True for the latest test of this facility covenant on or before the as-of date 30-Sep-2026 (one per facility x covenant).
columns.name: is_latest_test

columns.comment: Date of the previous test of the same facility covenant.
columns.name: prior_test_date

columns.comment: Actual at the previous test (x).
columns.name: prior_actual

columns.comment: actual - prior_actual (x); positive = the ratio rose since the previous test.
columns.name: actual_change_vs_prior

columns.comment: Headroom at the previous test (fraction).
columns.name: prior_headroom_pct

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year of the test date (FY2026 = Apr 2026 - Mar 2027).
columns.name: test_fiscal_year

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal quarter of the test date, e.g. FY2026-Q2.
columns.name: test_fiscal_quarter_label

columns.comment: True for tests in the current fiscal year (FY2026, from 1-Apr-2026).
columns.name: is_current_fy_test

columns.comment: Facility type of the tested facility (e.g. Term Loan, Revolving Credit Facility).
columns.name: facility_type

columns.comment: Current facility status: Active, Matured or Prepaid.
columns.name: facility_status

columns.comment: True when the facility is active at the as-of date.
columns.name: is_facility_active

columns.comment: Facility drawn balance at the test month-end, USD (the exposure the test relates to).
columns.name: drawn_usd_at_test

columns.comment: Facility limit at the test month-end, USD.
columns.name: limit_usd_at_test

columns.comment: True when the client is on the credit watchlist at the as-of date 30-Sep-2026 (today's status, for 'tight covenant but not on the watchlist').
columns.name: client_on_watchlist_as_of

comment: Financial covenant tests (brief 5.3 / 5.4): one row per facility x covenant (Net Debt/EBITDA leverage maximum, ICR interest-cover minimum) x test date from FY2023 (quarterly tests plus annual tests on the spread, e.g. Sunda's FY2025 test on 15-May-2026), with threshold, actual, headroom %, headroom bucket, breach / waiver flags, the previous test and the facility balance at the test month-end. is_latest_test marks the latest test of each facility covenant on or before 30-Sep-2026 - filter on it for 'at the latest test' questions (e.g. clients breaching or within 10% headroom on a leverage covenant). Headroom is a fraction: (threshold - actual) / threshold for maximum covenants, (actual - threshold) / threshold for minimum covenants; negative = breached. Grain: one row per facility x covenant type x test date.
